description: A fast game of diagonal moves and forced jumps on an eight by eight board.

sections.markdown:
Pieces sit on the dark squares and move diagonally forward, one square at a time.

- To capture, **jump** over an adjacent enemy piece onto the empty square behind it.
- **Captures are mandatory**: if you can jump, you must.
- A piece that reaches the far row is **crowned** and from then on moves diagonally in every direction.

You win when your opponent has no move left, because every piece was captured or blocked.
